summary: Iteration 2: Re-verified backend fixes + full frontend E2E. Backend: 53/53 pytest pass (up from 47 baseline). OTP verify now returns 200 with token+user; /payments/status/{session_id} responds gracefully; claim auto-approval works against seeded demo travel policy. Frontend: landing, login (password), dashboard (shows 1 active TR-* policy, AI recommendations, activity feed), products (with filter chips + data-testids per product), quote 4-step wizard, policies page, claims page, admin login + role-based redirect (customer blocked from /admin), and all 8 admin subpages (Overview, Customers, Leads, Analytics, Claims, Products, Campaigns, Voice) load without errors.

minor.issue: Recharts logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings when container has 0 width at first paint (cosmetic, charts render correctly after layout settles)

ui_bugs.issue: In Emergent preview env, the 'Made with Emergent' badge overlaps the bottom-right gold chat toggle (data-testid='ai-chat-toggle'). Programmatic clicks do not open the ai-chat-panel because the badge intercepts pointer events. Component code itself (/app/frontend/src/components/app/AIChat.jsx) is correct: setOpen toggle + ai-chat-panel + ai-chat-input + ai-chat-send testids exist. In production (no Emergent badge) this won't occur. Recommend moving the toggle to bottom-24 right-6 or increasing z-index above Emergent overlay.

issues: On first paint some Recharts containers log width/height(-1) warnings in console (cosmetic)

action_items: Consider raising AIChat toggle z-index or repositioning (bottom-24 right-6) to avoid overlap with Emergent 'Made with' badge in preview environments
Optional: set min-height on Recharts ResponsiveContainer wrappers to silence width(-1)/height(-1) warnings
critical_code_review_comments: AIChat floating toggle at bottom-6 right-6 collides visually with the Emergent preview badge; consider a small offset or higher z-index.
Many buttons on Products/Quote pages render as type='submit' (HTML default); consider adding type='button' to non-form-submission buttons to prevent accidental form submission.
Backend test coverage is good (53 tests across all routers). Consider adding tests for /claims/{id}/action edge cases (double approve, reject then approve) and Stripe webhook path.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows work; AI chat open is blocked only in preview env by Emergent badge)
